MOCHI:

2️⃣video prompt:

Use the provided “Little Girl & Cat: The Dandelion Wish” storyboard as the direct visual reference for the entire 15-second cinematic animation sequence. Follow the exact storyboard pacing, emotional rhythm, gentle magical beats, countryside adventure flow, Ghibli-inspired hand-drawn composition, and smooth scene continuity from panel to panel. Expand every storyboard frame into highly expressive cinematic animation with warm pastoral charm, soft magical realism, tender girl-and-cat companionship, whimsical sky magic, and emotionally cohesive visual storytelling.

Maintain exact character consistency throughout all shots — Mika must keep the same short messy dark-brown hair, tiny yellow flower hair clip, round expressive eyes, soft childlike face, cream short-sleeve blouse, green pinafore-style dress, small brown crossbody satchel, warm rounded proportions, gentle curious personality, and heartfelt adventurous energy in every frame. Mochi the cat must remain identical in white-and-gray tabby fur pattern, round expressive eyes, small triangular ears, soft fluffy texture, alert tail, curious body language, and affectionate companion personality throughout the sequence. Preserve continuity of the sunny meadow, dandelions, wildflowers, rolling hills, distant village, windmill, soft clouds, warm daylight, golden petals, rainbow, picnic blanket, flower wreath, woven basket, pastel color palette, camera direction, and dreamy hand-drawn atmosphere across the entire short film.

STYLE:
cinematic 2D hand-drawn animation, Ghibli-inspired countryside fantasy, warm gentle magical realism, heartfelt childlike adventure, soft painterly backgrounds, lush meadow atmosphere, golden daylight, delicate linework, expressive character acting, whimsical environmental storytelling, dreamy pastoral landscape, floating dandelion seeds, soft watercolor textures, warm earthy palette, magical cloud emotion, cozy emotional pacing, family-friendly wonder, nostalgic animated film feeling, tender girl-and-cat companionship, poetic sky magic, peaceful rural fantasy.

FOCUS:
innocent wish, friendship, kindness, helping nature, magical dandelion seeds, emotional cloud transformation, flower gathering, handmade gift, gentle humor, warm meadow adventure, girl-and-cat companionship, soft sky magic, rainbow payoff, picnic happiness, peaceful ending, childlike gratitude, dreamy countryside mood.

CHARACTER DESIGN:

Mika:
A curious little girl with short messy dark-brown hair, a small yellow flower hair clip, large round expressive eyes, soft childlike facial features, wearing a cream short-sleeve blouse under a green pinafore-style green dress, brown shoes, and a small brown crossbody satchel. She has warm rounded proportions, gentle adventurous energy, and a kind innocent personality. Her expressions shift from wonder and concentration to concern, determination, joy, gratitude, and peaceful happiness.

Mochi:
A small fluffy cat with white-and-gray tabby fur, round bright eyes, small triangular ears, soft cheeks, and playful curious body language. Mochi moves with light bouncy steps, attentive ears, twitching tail, affectionate companionship, and expressive reactions to Mika’s discoveries.

Dandelion Wish:
A delicate white dandelion puff that becomes magical when Mika blows on it. Its seeds float upward into the sky like tiny glowing wishes, moving with the wind and later returning in a playful dance.

Magic Cloud:
A soft white cloud in the blue sky that briefly forms a sad face, then becomes happy after Mika and Mochi cheer it up with a handmade flower wreath. The cloud should feel gentle, cute, emotional, and non-threatening, like a friendly sky spirit.

[0s – 1s]
SHOT 1 — MIKA FINDS A DANDELION.
Wide cinematic shot of a bright flower meadow under a blue sky filled with soft clouds. Mika kneels among dandelions and wildflowers, discovering a perfect white dandelion puff while Mochi the cat watches curiously beside her. The distant hills and windmill glow in warm daylight.

Dialogue:
Mika: “So pretty…”

SFX:
Gentle breeze, birds singing, soft grass rustling.

Camera:
Wide establishing shot with a slow gentle push-in toward Mika and Mochi in the meadow.

[1s – 2s]
SHOT 2 — THE WISH.
Close-up shot of Mika holding the dandelion carefully in both hands. She closes her eyes and makes a quiet wish, her face calm and hopeful, while the meadow softly blurs behind her.

Dialogue:
Mika whispers: “I wish for a nice day.”

SFX:
Soft wind, tiny breath, faint magical shimmer.

Camera:
Close-up intimate push-in on Mika’s face and the dandelion.

[2s – 3s]
SHOT 3 — SEEDS INTO THE SKY.
Wide shot. Mika blows the dandelion puff, sending dozens of tiny seeds floating upward into the bright sky. Mochi looks up and meows as the seeds drift away like little white stars.

Dialogue:
Mochi: “Meow!”

SFX:
Wind whoosh, soft seed flutter, tiny sparkling chimes.

Camera:
Wide upward tracking shot following the seeds as they rise from Mika’s hand into the sky.

[3s – 4s]
SHOT 4 — THE SAD CLOUD.
Medium shot from the meadow looking upward. Mika and Mochi notice a fluffy cloud forming a sad face in the sky. Mika points at it with concern as the dandelion seeds swirl around the cloud.

Dialogue:
Mika: “Oh no!”

SFX:
Soft rumble, gentle wind, quiet worried musical note.

Camera:
Medium shot tilting from Mika’s pointing hand up toward the sad cloud.

[4s – 5s]
SHOT 5 — RUNNING TO HELP.
Wide cinematic shot. Mika and Mochi run through the meadow toward the distant windmill and open flower fields, determined to cheer up the sad cloud. Mika’s satchel bounces and Mochi trots quickly beside her.

Dialogue:
Mika: “Let’s cheer it up!”

SFX:
Footsteps through grass, wind, light playful music beginning.

Camera:
Wide side-tracking shot following Mika and Mochi as they hurry across the meadow.

[5s – 6s]
SHOT 6 — COLLECTING FLOWERS.
Medium shot. Mika kneels in the meadow picking colorful flowers into a small woven basket while Mochi sits nearby and watches. The flowers are bright, soft, and varied, glowing warmly in the sunlight.

Dialogue:
Mika: “These should help.”

Mochi: “Meow!”

SFX:
Leaves rustle, flower stems softly snapping, gentle breeze.

Camera:
Medium steady shot with a soft push-in on Mika collecting flowers.

[6s – 7s]
SHOT 7 — MAKING THE GIFT.
Medium cozy shot. Mika sits on a small blanket in the flower field, carefully weaving the colorful flowers into a wreath. Mochi watches closely beside her, curious and patient, as petals scatter gently around them.

Dialogue:
Mika: “This is for you.”

SFX:
Petals brushing, soft music, quiet purring.

Camera:
Medium intimate overhead-angled shot focused on Mika’s hands making the wreath.

[7s – 8s]
SHOT 8 — OFFERING TO THE CLOUD.
Wide shot. Mika stands in the meadow and raises the handmade flower wreath toward the sad cloud. Mochi sits beside her and meows upward, as wind lifts loose petals and dandelion seeds around them.

Dialogue:
Mochi: “Meow!”

SFX:
Wind rises gently, soft magical swell, flower petals fluttering.

Camera:
Wide upward shot framing Mika, Mochi, the raised wreath, and the cloud above.

[8s – 9s]
SHOT 9 — THE CLOUD SMILES.
Wide sky shot. The sad cloud slowly transforms into a happy smiling face as golden dandelion seeds dance around it. The sky brightens, and the mood changes from worried to joyful.

Dialogue:
No spoken dialogue, only a happy emotional reaction from the cloud through visual expression.

SFX:
Wind chime, soft sparkle, warm orchestral lift.

Camera:
Wide upward shot holding on the cloud as its expression becomes happy.

[9s – 10s]
SHOT 10 — THE RAINBOW.
Wide landscape shot. A beautiful rainbow appears across the sky over the meadow, windmill, and rolling hills. Mika and Mochi look up in wonder as the whole countryside turns warm and magical.

Dialogue:
Mika: “Wow!”

SFX:
Birds, gentle music, soft magical shimmer.

Camera:
Wide scenic pullback revealing the rainbow stretching across the countryside.

[10s – 11s]
SHOT 11 — THE SEEDS RETURN.
Medium shot. Dandelion seeds float back down around Mika and Mochi in a playful dance. Mika reaches up with delight, and Mochi watches the seeds drift past his nose.

Dialogue:
Mika: “They came back!”

SFX:
Seed flutter, soft laughter, light airy chimes.

Camera:
Medium circular tracking shot around Mika and Mochi as seeds swirl gently.

[11s – 12s]
SHOT 12 — SAYING THANKS.
Close-up emotional shot of Mika smiling warmly while holding a few dandelion stems. Mochi sits beside her, looking up at the sky as Mika thanks the happy cloud.

Dialogue:
Mika: “Thank you!”

SFX:
Soft breeze, warm musical note, faint purr.

Camera:
Close-up push-in on Mika’s grateful expression and the floating seeds around her.

[12s – 13s]
SHOT 13 — PICNIC TIME.
Wide cozy shot. Mika and Mochi sit together on a picnic blanket in the flower meadow, enjoying a small picnic with fruit, bread, and treats from a basket. The sky is peaceful, the rainbow fades softly, and the meadow glows with happiness.

Dialogue:
Mochi: “Meow!”

SFX:
Happy ambience, soft cloth movement, distant birds.

Camera:
Wide gentle push-in toward the picnic blanket and the relaxed pair.

[13s – 14s]
SHOT 14 — RESTING TOGETHER.
Medium tender shot. Mika lies back in the grass beside Mochi, smiling up at the sky. Mochi rests comfortably next to her, and both enjoy the quiet warmth of the day they helped create.

Dialogue:
Mika: “What a nice day.”

SFX:
Wind, soft birds, peaceful meadow ambience.

Camera:
Medium overhead-angled shot drifting slowly above Mika and Mochi in the grass.

[14s – 15s]
SHOT 15 — HAPPY GOODBYE.
Wide final shot. Mika stands in the meadow near the distant windmill, waving goodbye toward the sky as Mochi sits beside her. Dandelion seeds float through the golden air, and the countryside feels peaceful, bright, and full of gentle magic.

Dialogue:
Mika: “See you tomorrow!”

FINAL VISUAL:
Mika and Mochi stand together in the warm meadow, waving goodbye beneath a soft glowing sky, with dandelion seeds drifting around them, the distant windmill on the horizon, and the day ending in quiet magical happiness.

On-screen ending mood:
A feeling of warmth, kindness, gratitude, friendship, gentle magic, and peaceful countryside joy.

SFX:
Warm wind, birds, distant soft bells, gentle music fading.

Camera:
Slow cinematic pullback revealing the full flower meadow, windmill, soft clouds, and Mika and Mochi’s happy final pose.
